title: Have you ever ...? (present perfect 3)
summary: Present perfect для жизненного опыта: **Have you ever been to ...?**, **I've never ...**, а также разница между **been** и **gone**.
ru:
## Опыт «за всю жизнь»
Present perfect нужен, когда мы говорим о периоде **от прошлого до сейчас** — например, обо всей жизни человека. Нам важно, было ли это вообще, а не когда именно.
> Have you **been** to Italy? — Ты бывала в Италии?
> I've **seen** this actor before. — Я уже видела этого актёра раньше.
> My uncle has **had** many jobs. — У моего дяди было много работ.

## ever и never
- **ever** — «когда-либо», в вопросах
- **never** — «никогда» (= not ever), в утверждениях; отрицание уже есть, второе не нужно
> Have you **ever** eaten sushi? — Ты когда-нибудь ела суши?
> Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.
> I've **never** ridden a horse. — Я никогда не ездила на лошади.

## Сколько раз?
- **once** — один раз, **twice** — два раза, **three times** — три раза
> How many times have you **read** this book? — Сколько раз ты читала эту книгу?
> I've read it **twice**. — Я читала её дважды.

## been и gone
Это частая ловушка.
- **has gone to** — уехал и сейчас там (его здесь нет)
- **has been to** — ездил и уже вернулся
> Sam has **gone** to Paris. — Сэм уехал в Париж (он там).
> Sam has **been** to Paris. — Сэм бывал в Париже (сейчас не там).

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I have never not seen it.~~ → I have **never** seen it. (never уже отрицание)
- ~~Did you ever be in London?~~ → Have you ever **been** to London?
- ~~I have been to London last year.~~ → I **went** to London last year. (с «last year» — past simple)
- ~~Have you ever went there?~~ → Have you ever **gone**/**been** there? (нужно причастие)
en:
## Life experience
We use the present perfect for a period of time **from the past until now**, for example a person's life. We say *if* something happened, not *when*.
> Have you **been** to Italy?
> I've **seen** this actor before.
> My uncle has **had** many jobs.

## ever and never
- **ever** = at any time in your life (in questions)
- **never** = not ever (in statements; don't use another negative)
> Have you **ever** eaten sushi? — Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.
> I've **never** ridden a horse.

## How many times?
- **once** = one time, **twice** = two times, **three times** ...
> How many times have you read this book? — I've read it **twice**.

## been and gone
- **has gone to** = he went there and is still there
- **has been to** = he went there and came back
> Sam has **gone** to Paris. (He is in Paris now.)
> Sam has **been** to Paris. (He isn't there now.)

## Common mistakes
- ~~I have never not seen it.~~ → I have **never** seen it.
- ~~I have been to London last year.~~ → I **went** to London last year.
- ~~Have you ever went there?~~ → Have you ever **been** there?
structure:
## Формы
| Утверждение | Отрицание | Вопрос |
|---|---|---|
| I have seen it. | I haven't seen it. / I have never seen it. | Have you (ever) seen it? |
| She has been there. | She hasn't been there. / She has never been there. | Has she (ever) been there? |

## Краткие ответы
- Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.
- Yes, he has. / No, he hasn't.
- Yes, **once**. / Yes, **twice**. / Yes, **three times**.

## been или gone
| Форма | Значение |
|---|---|
| has **been** to | был и вернулся |
| has **gone** to | уехал, ещё там |

## Формула
> Have / Has + подлежащее + (**ever**) + past participle ... ?
> Подлежащее + have / has + **never** + past participle

exercises.title: Вопросы с ever
exercises.instruction: Составьте вопрос **Have you ever ...?** из слов в скобках.
exercises.example: (visit / Japan) → Have you ever visited Japan?

answers: Have you ever been to Spain?
Have you ever eaten Thai food?
Have you ever lost your keys?
Have you ever ridden a horse?
Have you ever broken your arm?
Have you ever met a famous person?

exercises.title: Present perfect: поставьте глагол
exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол в скобках в present perfect.

items.text: My brother {{has travelled|has traveled}} to many countries.
I {{have never seen|'ve never seen}} snow.
We {{have visited|'ve visited}} that museum three times.
They {{have never been|'ve never been}} to Moscow.
How many books {{have}} you {{read}} this year?

items.q: Where is Kate? — She has ___ to the shop. She'll be back soon.
items.why: Её сейчас нет, она в магазине — **gone**.

items.q: My parents have ___ to Turkey. They are on the beach now.
Have you ever ___ to a concert?
I ___ a bike, but I've never ridden a motorbike.
She ___ in a big city. She lives in a village.

items.text: Have you ever been to London? — No, I {{haven't|have not}}.
Has your friend ever lost his passport? — Yes, he {{has}}.
Have they ever met you? — No, they {{haven't|have not}}.
Have you ever flown in a plane? — Yes, I {{have}}.
Has it ever snowed in May there? — No, it {{hasn't|has not}}.
How many times have you seen this film? — {{Twice}}.

items.prompt: Я никогда не была в Лондоне.
answers: I have never been to London.
He has been to Turkey twice.

items.prompt: Мария уехала в Испанию (она сейчас там).
Мы никогда не видели это животное.
answers: We have never seen this animal.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями о своём опыте.

items.sample: I've been to Turkey and Kazakhstan.

items.prompt: Что вы никогда не делали, но хотели бы?
items.sample: I've never flown in a helicopter, but I'd like to.

items.prompt: Сколько раз вы смотрели свой любимый фильм?
items.sample: I've seen my favourite film five times.

items.prompt: Задайте вопрос другу о его опыте.
items.sample: Have you ever climbed a mountain?
